{{Top|leg}}
'''Sea shell horns''' were large [[Horn/Legends|horns]] that were hung within the guard towers that encircled the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The horns were blown by the [[warrior monk]] manning the tower to signal to others that trouble was approaching. During the [[Karak's renegades|renegade]] [[Raid on Fitsay|attack]] on the settlement, one of the warrior monks used the horn on their tower to sound the alarm. A similar horn was installed in the center of the [[Audience Hall]] in [[Fitsay]], and was blown to announce the arrival of [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
